questions.prompt: Which country did Portugal hand back to China in 1999?
questions.fact: Portugal had tried to return it in the 1970s and China declined, preferring to wait.

questions.prompt: Which structure carries signals away from a neuron's body?
questions.fact: The longest in a human runs from the base of the spine to the toe, around a metre in a single cell.

questions.prompt: Which country won the most medals at the first modern Olympics?
questions.fact: It won the most medals overall, while the United States won the most first places.

questions.prompt: Which film features the character Tony Montana?
questions.fact: It was a remake of a 1932 film, relocated from Prohibition Chicago to 1980s Miami.

questions.prompt: Which country contains the world's largest cave passage?
questions.fact: Son Doong is large enough to hold a city block, and has its own jungle and weather system inside.

questions.prompt: Which novel opens with a family arriving at a lighthouse-facing holiday house?
questions.fact: Its middle section compresses ten years and several deaths into a few pages, mostly in brackets.

questions.prompt: What is the term for the practice of hiding a system's internal detail?
questions.fact: Every layer of a computer is one, which is why you can use a phone without knowing what a transistor is.
